接口 ProfileBanList

BanList<PlayerProfile>
public interface ProfileBanList extends BanList<PlayerProfile>
针对玩家配置文件封禁的 BanList.

原文： A BanList targeting player profile bans.

    • addBan

      @Nullable @Deprecated <E extends BanEntry<? super PlayerProfile>> E addBan(@NotNull @NotNull PlayerProfile target, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String reason, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.Date expires, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String source)
      已过时。
      use addBan(com.destroystokyo.paper.profile.PlayerProfile, String, Date, String)
      参数:
      target - the target of the ban
      reason - reason for the ban, null indicates implementation default
      expires - date for the ban's expiration (unban), or null to imply forever
      source - source of the ban, null indicates implementation default
      返回:
      the entry for the newly created ban, or the entry for the (updated) previous ban
      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if ProfilePlayer has an invalid UUID

    • addBan

      @Nullable @Nullable BanEntry<PlayerProfile> addBan(@NotNull PlayerProfile target, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String reason, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.Date expires, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String source)
      从接口复制的说明: BanList
      添加一个封禁到这个列表。如果以前的封禁存在，这将更新以前的封禁.

      原文： Adds a ban to this list. If a previous ban exists, this will update the previous entry.

      指定者:
      addBan 在接口中 BanList<PlayerProfile>
      参数:
      target - 封禁目标

      原文：the target of the ban

      reason - 封禁理由，null则使用默认

      原文：reason for the ban, null indicates implementation default

      expires - 封禁的截止日期(解除封禁)，null则为永远封禁

      原文：date for the ban's expiration (unban), or null to imply forever

      source - 封禁来源，null则使用默认

      原文：source of the ban, null indicates implementation default

      返回:
      新创建的封禁条目，或为更新之前的封禁

      原文：the entry for the newly created ban, or the entry for the (updated) previous ban

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if ProfilePlayer has an invalid UUID
